title: Recover missing Universaarl Dimension Values route
purpose: Find a reproducible UI route for the missing starter Dimension Values without creating master data, drafts, preview or posting.
entryCriteria: TARGET-023 proves PRODUCTLINE, COSTCENTER and CHANNEL are visible after reopen.
TARGET-023 proves SOFTWARE, ADMIN and DIRECT are visible as first Dimension Values.
TARGET-023 blocks additional values because current Page-537/List-Edit/New/Grid route does not persist them.

No master data, document, preview or posting is executed.

lookahead.reason: Master data should use the new dimension design only after dimensions/values are visible.
